\chapter{Introduction and Background}

\section{System Overview}
This report outlines the architecture and design of a high-performance scientific authoring suite. The primary objective is to eliminate interactive latency while maintaining full reproducibility and determinism across document builds.

\section{Architectural Pillars}
Three foundational principles guide the system implementation:
\begin{enumerate}
  \item \textbf{Sub-millisecond responsiveness:} Eliminating UI stalls through zero-copy binary IPC.
  \item \textbf{Absolute memory safety:} Leveraging Rust's ownership system and sandboxed WebAssembly plugins.
  \item \textbf{Local-first persistence:} Storing documents as clean, human-readable UTF-8 files on disk.
\end{enumerate}
